Title: Four Long Arms, Whirling
Source Situation / Theme: At Harvard, Tara's parents visit and try to bring her back through a religious blessing; she refuses and confronts a break in identity.
Design Extraction: A new location cannot prevent the old world from entering. Boundaries become real when they cost connection.
Game Transformation: Allow a campus visit to interrupt ordinary gameplay and become a boundary sequence involving hospitality, belief, and refusal.
Guardrail: Faith is not the enemy; coercive use of belief is the conflict.

Title: Gambling for Redemption
Source Situation / Theme: After the visit, Tara falls into depression, stops working, books a return home, and discovers written evidence that her family has recast her as corrupted.
Design Extraction: Desperation can make return feel like the only path, while written evidence may finally clarify the terms of belonging.
Game Transformation: Represent reduced capacity through optional support and narrowed tasks, not punishing controls; the return journey uncovers decisive correspondence.
Guardrail: Mental-health struggle is not a debuff to grind away; support routes remain available.

Title: Family
Source Situation / Theme: Tara is close to failing her PhD; a supervisor challenges her; Tyler confronts the parents and chooses to support her; she slowly recovers and completes the degree.
Design Extraction: Chosen family becomes visible through action, truth, and sustained support rather than blood alone.
Game Transformation: Combine research recovery, mentor accountability, and a sibling alliance into a long-form restoration chapter.
Guardrail: Recovery is uneven; achievement does not erase grief.

Title: Watching the Buffalo
Source Situation / Theme: After completing her PhD, Tara returns to Idaho, attends a funeral, sees the family divide, and understands the mountain differently.
Design Extraction: Returning with distance does not restore the past; it can reveal patterns that were invisible from inside.
Game Transformation: Build a quiet epilogue revisit where routes, homes, and people are observed rather than conquered.
Guardrail: No triumphal return. The landscape retains beauty and grief.

Title: Educated
Source Situation / Theme: Tara reflects on estrangement, ongoing sibling ties, selfhood, and education as the power to remake one's understanding and life.
Design Extraction: Education is not a completion badge. It is the continuing reconstruction of experience and authorship of self.
Game Transformation: End with a player-edited memory journal and a relational epilogue generated from choices, capabilities, and boundaries.
Guardrail: No single 'correct' ending; clarity and agency matter more than maximum reconciliation.
